description:
Found by fz-kdt.69.2: with total edge emission, the residual CallSite
retract-and-remint (33/12 first-appearance excess on predicate/take_drop) has
ONE cause -- analyze_tail/deliver_tail_value truncate a tail chain at a call
whose ReturnType has not arrived, so callsites behind it go unreached for a
round (the reached set is non-monotone). This violates the availability-per-
READ rule entry_scope's captures already state.

The 69.2 builder measured a fix (continue the walk past an absent delivered
value) removing the churn entirely AND improving inventory (214->200) and
evals (-20/-9/-101) -- but the adversarial review could NOT reproduce those
numbers under two faithful reconstructions. START FROM A PATCH, not prose:
re-derive the fix, publish the diff in this ticket, and re-measure before
believing any number. Inventory pins will re-pin downward if the improvement
is real (lowering is safe-by-construction; verify output correctness via
canon byte-compare and the full matrix).
title: analyze_tail truncates chains at absent return evidence: the last callsite-churn source
